Entry-level monthly subscription with automatic CDK and redemption-link delivery after payment.

What You Receive

  • A CDK for one month of ChatGPT Go
  • A self-service redemption link matched to the CDK
  • A delivery record available on the order page

Delivery starts automatically after payment is confirmed and typically completes within 1–30 minutes.

  • Confirm that the selected plan, region, and account are correct.
  • Use a stable, compliant network connection and avoid frequently switching proxy nodes.

Warranty and Support

Not Covered by Warranty

  • Account bans, account-specific problems, or platform risk controls.
  • Account-side issues such as account sharing, policy-violating use, or frequent IP switching.

Codex SMS Verification Guide

Number retrieval URL:https://sms.kkdos.store/

Browser and network:Open this page in Safari, Chrome, or Edge, not the WeChat in-app browser. A stable residential network is recommended when accessing the OpenAI verification page.

1. Sign in to the retrieval page

Open the retrieval URL in your order, enter the CDK received after purchase, and complete verification.

2. Retrieve a US number

Copy the assigned +1 US number to the Codex / OpenAI phone verification page, then request an SMS.

3. Receive the verification code

After requesting the SMS, return to the retrieval page and click the button to retrieve the verification code. Delivery can be delayed; allow approximately 1 minute.

Frequently Asked Questions

“This phone number has been used recently”

This is a platform risk-control restriction. When linking a second or third account to a long-term number, wait approximately 1 hour or change networks before retrying.

“Unable to send an SMS to this number”

Return to the retrieval page and use the number replacement option if a verification code cannot be sent.

“Too many phone verification requests”

Do not repeatedly request verification codes. Wait a while or switch to a stable network before trying again.

“Maximum number of linked accounts reached”

The number cannot be used for another account. Replace it on the retrieval page.

“Something went wrong” or a network error

Check your connection and retry on a stable residential network.

No verification code received after checking

Wait approximately 1 minute. If no code arrives, you can replace the number. Once the system successfully receives a verification code, the number can no longer be replaced.

No number replacements remaining

The system provides a limited number of self-service replacements. Contact support once these have been used.

“System under maintenance”

The service may be upgrading or adjusting its number pool. Try again later or contact support for its status.
